name: Artistry Shaman Spirit
body:
A shaman who selects the artistry spirit is always stylish in dress and coiffure, beautiful and has a pleasant-to-listen-to voice.

Spirit Magic Spells: play instrument (1st), minor image (2nd), major image (3rd), majestic image (4th), joyful rapture (5th), irresistible dance (6th), waves of ecstasy (7th), scintillating pattern (8th), resplendent mansion (9th)

Hexes: A shaman who chooses the artistry spirit can select from the following hexes.

Behind the Mask (Su)

While you are wearing a costume or under the effects of disguise self or alter self, you gain a +2 bonus on Will saving throws to resist mind-affecting effects. At 11th level, the bonus on Will saving throws increases to +4. You may also grant this bonus to an ally within 30 feet as a standard action. In such a case the benefit lasts for 1 minute per shaman level.

Benefit of Wisdom (Ex)

The shaman relies on their wisdom rather than intellect to gain and retain the stories they then can use later. They can use their Wisdom modifier instead of their Intelligence modifier on all Intelligence-based skill checks.

Insight into Desire (Sp)

As a standard action, you can learn the desires of any creature you can see within 100 feet, as if you had concentrated until the third round of the detect desires spell. As usual for detect desires, the target can attempt a Will save to negate the effect. Once affected by this hex, the creature cannot be the target of this hex again for 24 hours.

Intuitive Aesthetics (Ex)

The shaman relies on their knack rather than their charm. They can use their Wisdom modifier instead of their Charisma modifier on all Charisma-based skill checks.

Open to the Experience (Sp)

The target is more susceptible to emotional shifts. They take a -2 penalty on all saves vs. spells or effects with the emotion descriptor and the DC to demoralize or induce despair with Intimidate or Bluff is reduced by 2 (See New Skill Uses). This hex lasts for a number of rounds equal to 3 + the shaman’s Wisdom modifier.

Performative Magic (Su)

The shaman’s intuitive performance ability grants them the ability to tap into bardic magic. The shaman can add a number of spells from the bard spell list equal to their Charisma modifier (minimum 1) to the list of shaman spells they can prepare. To cast these spells they must have a Charisma score equal to at least 10 + the spell’s level, but the saving throw DCs of these spells are based on their Wisdom rather than Charisma. When they cast these spells, they are treated as divine rather than arcane. Each time the shaman gains a level after taking this hex, she can choose to replace one of these spells with a new spell on the bard spell list.

Spirit Animal: The shaman’s spirit animal appears to be well-groomed. It gains a +4 bonus on all Charisma-based skill checks.

Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the artistry spirit as their spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability.

Costume (Sp)

You can change your appearance at will, as disguise self with a caster level equal to your shaman level. At 7th level, you can instead physically transform, as alter self. At 11th level, this ability lasts until you dismiss it or use it again, allowing you to keep it active while you sleep.

Greater Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the artistry spirit as their spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability upon having access to the greater version of that spirit.

Once More with Gusto (Ex)

Once per day, you can reattempt any previously failed Craft, Artistry or Perform check. On this attempt, you gain a +10 competence bonus on the check.

True Spirit Ability: A shaman who chooses the artistry spirit as their spirit or wandering spirit gains the following ability upon having access to the true version of that spirit.

Bardic Performance: The shaman may resonate with their spirit to perform for their ally’s benefit. You gain bardic performance equal to a bard of half your shaman levels.

Manifestation: At 20th level, you become an avatar of emotional experience. You receive a bonus on all saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier. Additionally, you become immune to fear and despair effects and can ignore any emotion effect you do not wish to benefit or suffer from. As a standard action, you can remove all emotion, fear, or despair effects with a touch. On a successful touch you can perform a targeted dispel (as the spell dispel magic) attempt using your shaman level as your caster level to dispel the emotion, fear or despair effect. You may use this ability at will.
